draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.60, the 239th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 21st of 22 at LB. He went 259th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing concerns: broad jump (17th percentile). College production: 61 tackles in 2020, 12th of 22 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Los Angeles Rams. 83 career games and 5 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 3 in 2024. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (14th percentile), passes defended 0 (19th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 off-ball linebacker who played: 19 combined tackles against a median of 66, below the norm.
